svg.text: The top-view road label: sparse points, then pseudo points
LiDAR Road Detection · part 2 · one KITTI scan on the 400 x 200 grid
pseudo points: circles of radius 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 m, every 10 degrees, around each road point
Which cells get a road label?
From points alone 3319 cells; with pseudo points 28401 cells, 8.6 times more.
cell with a point inside the camera view
Drawn as blocks of 4 x 4 cells; a block is coloured when any of its cells is set. The far edge (46 m) is at the top.
